name: proxy-client
description: A Ocot Client application with various functionalities.

scripts.dev: node scripts/switch-env.js dev && concurrently "tsc -w -p tsconfig.json" "node scripts/dev-server.js"
scripts.build: node scripts/switch-env.js prod && npm run build:ts && npm run bundle
scripts.build:watch: node scripts/switch-env.js dev && concurrently "tsc -w -p tsconfig.json" "esbuild build/main.js --bundle --outfile=dist/bundle.js --format=iife --watch"
scripts.build:dev: node scripts/switch-env.js dev && npm run build:ts && esbuild build/main.js --bundle --outfile=dist/bundle.js --format=iife --sourcemap
scripts.env:dev: node scripts/switch-env.js dev && npm run build
scripts.env:prod: node scripts/switch-env.js prod && npm run build
